javascript:(async()=>{try{const b=Uint8Array.from(atob(''),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));const s=await new Response(new Blob([b]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'))).text();try{(0,eval)(s)}catch(e1){const u=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([s],{type:'text/javascript'}));const t=document.createElement('script');t.src=u;t.onerror=()=>alert('AutoTask: stránka blokuje spuštění skriptu (CSP).');document.body.appendChild(t)}}catch(e){alert('AutoTask chyba: '+e.message)}})()
